description: DRAFT — not wired into the app. Something that happened, written by a person, app, or device so that flows can react to it. Events are written into a private space (a flow's inbox, a group, or the owner's personal space), never into the public repo.

main.description: A single event. The record author (the DID whose space repo it lives in) is the sender; there is deliberately no self-declared 'from' field.

event.description: Event name that triggers match on, e.g. 'arrived-home' or 'deploy-failed'. Same role as the deepLink trigger's 'event'.

title.description: Short human-readable summary. Safe to show in a notification.

urgency.description: Delivery hint. 'high' may wake the device via Web Push; 'low' waits for the next foreground sync.

data.description: Optional flat key/value payload. Only keys a trigger explicitly allows are exposed to action templates.

expiresAt.description: After this time the event must not fire flows (e.g. 'I'm 5 minutes away' is useless an hour later).

eventData.description: Flat map of string/number/boolean values. Nested objects are rejected so templates stay predictable. Max 16 keys, values max 256 chars (enforced by the client schema).
